item.title: Trump Officials Revise How Title IX Sex Discrimination Rules Are Enforced

item.title: Couple Accused of Killing Their Son-in-Law in Bay Area Park
item.description: Jonathan McKinsey, an engineer who worked in the games department for The New York Times, was fatally shot Saturday in a San Francisco suburb. The police have accused his parents-in-law, both 76.

item.title: These Republicans Have Called on Trump to Ban U.S. Diesel Exports
